resources.string: Run unrestricted shell commands with Termux permissions. Commands can read or change Termux files and use the network. Output used by the Agent is sent to your model Provider. No root, SSH server, or overlay permission is required.
Copy setup command and open Termux
Paste the command below into Termux once. It preserves your existing settings and allows authorized apps to request commands. Then return here.
Connected. Return to Mochi and enable the Termux tools and Skill.
Setup required. Initialize Termux, run the setup command and grant permission.
Connection failed. Check external-app access, permissions and Termux battery restrictions.
